message.content:
Based on my search, here are several free online auto repair estimate tools available:

## Top Free Online Auto Repair Estimate Tools

### 1. **RepairPal Estimator**
One of the most well-known and trusted resources. Enter your zip code to get fair pricing estimates for repairs from RepairPal Certified shops, with guaranteed prices for 30 days. Covers a wide range of mechanical and maintenance repairs.

### 2. **YourMechanic Estimates**
Provides free instant auto repair and maintenance estimates with detailed price breakdowns showing parts and labor costs separately. You can also book a mobile mechanic to come to your home or office.

### 3. **Otto (ottofixit.com)**
An AI-powered tool where you upload a photo of your car damage and get an instant free estimate in under 30 seconds. It analyzes thousands of real repair invoices and connects you with verified local shops. Also helps compare insurance claim vs. out-of-pocket costs.

### 4. **Instant Estimator**
A free online system that automatically assesses and costs cosmetic auto body and paint damage. You can submit photos for more precise quotes and get connected to up to 3 authorized auto body repair facilities in your area.

### 5. **WhoCanFixMyCar (UK-based)**
Free car repair cost calculator where you select your vehicle make, model, and postcode to get instant average repair costs and savings potential when booking through their platform.

### 6. **FreeAutoMechanic.com**
Offers free auto repair estimates for US cars and trucks from 1990-2013. Provides labor time guides that you can multiply by your local shop's hourly rate to estimate costs. Note: Response times may take up to a week due to high demand.

### 7. **Mechlance**
Connects you with mobile mechanics who come to you. Get instant free estimates from their network and save up to 50% on services, with secure escrow payment protection.

### 8. **Certified Calculator Auto Repair Costs Calculator**
A simple calculator tool where you input labor cost, parts cost, and tax rate to get a total repair cost estimate.

## Specialized Body Shop Estimators

Several collision repair shops also offer free online estimators:
- **Westside Collision** – Free auto body repair estimate calculator for windshield and body damage
- **City of Stars Collision Center** – Free online auto body repair estimates with same-day response
- **Cleveland Auto Repair** – Online calculator with VIN decoding for personalized estimates

## Tips for Using These Tools

- **Compare multiple estimates** to ensure fair pricing
- **Be specific** about your vehicle (year, make, model, trim) and the exact repair needed
- **Upload photos** when possible for more accurate quotes, especially for body damage
- **Check if estimates include** both parts and labor, as well as any additional fees
- **Verify shop credentials** before booking repairs

---

Sources:
1. https://www.repairpal.com/estimator
2. https://www.yourmechanic.com/estimates
3. https://www.ottofixit.com/
4. https://www.instantestimator.com/
5. https://www.whocanfixmycar.com/car-service-cost-calculator
6. https://www.freeautomechanic.com/free-auto-repair-estimates-online.html
7. https://mechlance.com/
8. https://certifiedcalculator.com/auto-repair-costs-calculator/
9. https://westsidecollision.com/auto-body-repair-estimate-calculator/
10. https://cityofstarscollision.com/online-estimator-tool/
11. https://thelandautorepair.com/optimizing-auto-repair-estimates-with-cleveland-auto-repairs-online-calculator/
